pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify promotion expiration dates before confirming
lesson.when: a customer asks to confirm a promotion's specific expiration date and retrieved records do not contain the exact end date
lesson.do: state only the confirmed discount details and express uncertainty regarding the exact end date without confirming or inventing a specific date
lesson.otherwise: confirming an unverified expiration date risks stating unsupported claims
